name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Gnome goes with Sable or Crossbow goes with Halfling.
Between Halfling and Human, one goes with Sable and the other with Wrenna.
Rapier goes with neither Sable nor Gnome.

hints.text: From the clue “Rapier goes with neither Sable nor Gnome” — Sable can't go with Rapier.
From the clue “Rapier goes with neither Sable nor Gnome” — Gnome can't go with Rapier.
Suppose Mara went with Halfling — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Mara goes with Halfling.
Halfling goes with Mara, so Sable can't go with Halfling.
Halfling goes with Mara, so Wrenna can't go with Halfling.
…but now the clue “Between Halfling and Human, one goes with Sable and the other with Wrenna” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Mara does not go with Halfling.

hints.text: Suppose Mara didn't go with Gnome — that hits a contradiction, so it does.
chain: Start by assuming Mara does not go with Gnome.
In Adventurer × Race, Mara must go with Human — every other Race is already crossed out for it.
Human goes with Mara, so Sable can't go with Human.
Human goes with Mara, so Wrenna can't go with Human.
…but now the clue “Between Halfling and Human, one goes with Sable and the other with Wrenna” can no longer hold — a contradiction.

hints.text: Mara goes with Gnome, so it can't also go with Human.
Gnome goes with Mara, so Sable can't go with Gnome.
Gnome goes with Mara, so Wrenna can't go with Gnome.
Mara goes with Gnome, but Rapier doesn't, so Mara doesn't go with Rapier.
In Adventurer × Weapon, Rapier must go with Wrenna — every other Adventurer is already crossed out for it.
Wrenna goes with Rapier, so it can't also go with Crossbow.
Wrenna goes with Rapier, so it can't also go with Dagger.

Crossbow goes with Halfling, so Gnome can't go with Crossbow.

Halfling goes with Crossbow, so it can't also go with Dagger.
Halfling goes with Crossbow, so it can't also go with Rapier.
Crossbow goes with Halfling, so Human can't go with Crossbow.
In Race × Weapon, Rapier must go with Human — every other Race is already crossed out for it.
Human goes with Rapier, so it can't also go with Dagger.
Human goes with Rapier, but Sable doesn't, so Sable doesn't go with Human.
Halfling goes with Crossbow, but Wrenna doesn't, so Wrenna doesn't go with Halfling.
Wrenna goes with Rapier, and Human goes with Rapier, so Wrenna goes with Human.
Mara goes with Gnome, but Crossbow doesn't, so Mara doesn't go with Crossbow.
Mara goes with Gnome, and Dagger goes with Gnome, so Mara goes with Dagger.
